pairs.subject: modal-stack
pairs.evidence: app/_components/Tooltip.tsx:95 Tooltip Escape dismissal does not stop propagation, allowing the containing modal's document listener to close a second layer on the same keypress.

techniques.evidence: app/_components/Tooltip.tsx:61 Tracks ancestor scrolling, but update only repositions: an off-screen anchor never dismisses its tooltip, and anchor/overlay geometry changes are not observed.
app/_components/IconAction.tsx:64 The supplied primitives delegate actions to callers and define no destructive operation whose reversibility or blast radius can be judged.
app/_components/Tooltip.tsx:95 The tooltip's Escape handler closes locally without stopping propagation; useDialogA11y's document handler can then close its containing modal.
app/_components/Modal.tsx:84 Modal claims modality, but its hook supplies Tab handling and scroll locking without making the background inert to assistive traversal or other focus navigation.
app/_components/Modal.tsx:70 Modal uses a raw layer number; Tooltip independently uses z-50, while Toast uses a named token, violating the requirement for one semantic layer scale.
app/_components/useDialogA11y.ts:16 The dialog/drawer registry stores only symbols and excludes independently opened tooltips, so it cannot provide typed, queryable ownership across overlay families.
